The loss uses a sigmoid link on the log-probability difference weighted by the advantage difference, aggregated using a smooth weighted mean influenced by the entropy gap signal as a soft regularizer. entropy_gap = entropy_w_mean - entropy_l_mean (fallback 0)
sigmoid_term = sigmoid(log_prob_w - log_prob_l)
weighted_loss = (1 - sigmoid_term) * adv_diff * weight

    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']

    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    entropy_w = batch.get('entropy_w_mean', ops.zeros_like(lpw))
    entropy_l = batch.get('entropy_l_mean', ops.zeros_like(lpl))

    entropy_gap = ops.sub(entropy_w, entropy_l)
    entropy_reg = ops.clamp(entropy_gap, 0.0, 1.0)

    mean_loss = ops.mean(weighted_loss)
    reg_term = ops.mean(entropy_reg) * 0.1
